value.summary: VMware CX production datastore - over-provisioned (thin over-commit)

eventTemplate.title: VMware CX datastore over-provisioned: {dims:datastore.name}
eventTemplate.description: Datastore {dims:datastore.name} is {alert_condition} {threshold}% provisioned (thin over-commit). Thin VMDKs can grow into space that does not exist and fill the datastore - the failure mode behind the 2026-06-20 PRODCXFIL01 outage (CX_IMG4 was 159% provisioned). Review provisioning vs free space and reclaim or expand the datastore before it fills.
